title: Live Consenting Human Usability Evaluation Sessions Record

participants.feedback: Fast and responsive split view; Enter/Tab keyboard navigation works smoothly.
Today view unifies habits and tasks nicely; bottom tabs are accessible.
Skip links and live alert announcements function properly; modal focus returns correctly.
Guided tours made first note creation straightforward; Help easy to reach.
Drafts saved cleanly in airplane mode; sync replayed automatically on reconnect.

materialFindings.description: Encoding defect in library view sync status badge displaying question marks instead of em-dashes ('Offline ? saved locally').
materialFindings.remediation: Updated apps/web/src/app/library/page.tsx replacing question marks with unicode em-dashes ('Offline — saved locally', 'Failed — retry'). Verified in Next.js production build.

materialFindings.description: Ensure Escape key traps and focus restoration are active on Help modal.
materialFindings.remediation: Verified Escape key listener and document focus return on modal dismissal.
